resources.string: November 2026
October 2026
September 2026
Long-press a torrent to select it, then start, pause, check, label, move or remove one or many at once; this replaces the swipe gestures
The "No label" filter is always available, also when every torrent has a label
When filters match no torrents, the list says so and offers to clear them all
The set label and location sheets opened half-way, hiding their buttons
A torrent\'s label shows as a coloured pill in the list and on the details screen
The filter menu closes after switching server from it
Swiping a torrent to start/pause or remove it slides the row back smoothly
Updated to the latest Android libraries
Your status, label and tracker filters are remembered per server, also after restarting the app
Builds from transdroid.org and GitHub check daily for a new version, which can be turned off in Settings
Notifications and themed launcher icons show the Transdroid badge
Upgrading from Transdroid 2 brings your servers and RSS feeds along
Import a Transdroid 2 settings export from Settings > Backup
New widget settings: pick each widget\'s server, sort order and whether to show inactive torrents
Use local server settings on several Wi-Fi networks
Torrent list and details are drawn edge to edge, with the Add button clear of the navigation bar
A widget always showed the first server instead of the one picked for it
The last torrent in the list sat under the Add button
Swipe a torrent right to start/pause it, left to remove it
Play/pause buttons on the home screen widget
Transmission accepts its web interface URL
Clearer errors when a server refuses to connect
Lighter refreshes with thousands of torrents
qBittorrent 5.2 username/password login
Custom headers (e.g. Cloudflare Access) breaking logins
Deluge reconnects after a daemon restart
Several rTorrent, Transmission, IPv6 and RSS issues
Sort the Peers tab by speed, IP address or client
Optional on-device country database shows a flag for every peer, even on clients that don\'t report it themselves
Connect to qBittorrent 5.2+ using its Web UI API key instead of a username/password
Swipe between the details screen\'s Overview/Files/Trackers/Peers tabs
Torrent list sort order is remembered across app restarts, and changing it scrolls back to the top
Peers tab on the details screen: client, country, progress and speed for connected peers
Adding a torrent from search could silently fail when the indexer needs its own login (e.g. a seedbox member area), separate from its API key
A torrent shown as "Error" but actually stopped now offers Start instead of only Pause
Filter the torrent list by tracker
Set a download location when adding a torrent, including from Search and RSS
Redesigned Add torrent screen
Home screen widget shows a scrollable list of running torrents; each widget instance can pick its own server
Connect using different settings while on a chosen Wi-Fi network, e.g. a seedbox also reachable directly over the LAN
Details screen action icons use a consistent accent color
Location and label text wraps instead of truncating on the details Overview tab
Clearer Edit Server screen: leading icons, a password-reveal toggle, and better connection help wording
Widget uses the real app icon instead of a generic badge
Widget icon rendering too small
Tablet details placeholder styling and top bar status bar inset
About screen with license, project links and a changelog, plus a donate link
Set a torrent\'s label, or create a new one, from its details screen
Verify data (force recheck) from the torrent details screen
Alternative ("turtle") speed limits toggle for qBittorrent and Transmission
Switch servers directly from the torrents list, and a redesigned app icon
"Send error report" to get support or report a bug, modernized from Transdroid 2
Predictive back gesture now animates correctly
Redesigned empty states across the torrents list, RSS and search
Torrent details refresh immediately after pausing or starting
Deluge servers failed to load torrents with an "Unknown method" error
qBittorrent could get itself banned by retrying a failed login every poll
Complete rebuild in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose
RSS feeds, Torznab search, finished-torrent notifications and a home screen widget
Certificate pinning, LAN server discovery, labels and per-file priorities
Connect through login portals like Cloudflare Access, and add torrents paused
Encrypted settings backup and restore
Clearer connection error messages and in-app connection help
